_about: Search settings used by build.js. Fill these in as you set up each account, then run `node build.js` and publish. See docs/seo.md.
_googleSiteVerification: Google Search Console > Add property > URL prefix > HTML tag. Paste only the content="..." value.
_bingSiteVerification: Bing Webmaster Tools > Add site > HTML Meta Tag (msvalidate.01). Paste only the content value. Skip if you import from Search Console.
_addressLocality: The city shown on your Google Business Profile (address hidden). Leave empty until the profile is set up so the two always match.
_sameAs: Full links to your public profiles once they exist: Google Business Profile share link, Yelp, Nextdoor, Facebook, Instagram.
